name: unmove
description: File transfer application with TVDB/TMDB integration for organizing media files. Identify TV series and movies, rename them properly, and move them to your media library. This template uses a single /data mount for INSTANT file moves (no copy+delete). Your downloads and media folders should be subdirectories of the Data Path. NOTE: Instant moves only work if downloads and media are on the SAME physical disk. If they are on different disks, the app will automatically fall back to copy+delete. To guarantee instant moves, mount a specific disk (e.g., /mnt/disk1) instead of /mnt/user.

paths.name: Data Path
paths.description: Parent directory containing downloads and media folders. Using a single mount enables INSTANT file moves instead of copy+delete.

variables.name: DOWNLOAD_PATH
variables.description: Path to downloads folder inside container (relative to Data Path /data/)

variables.name: MEDIA_PATH
variables.description: Path to media folder inside container (relative to Data Path /data/)

variables.name: TVDB API Key
variables.description: Your TVDB API key (get one at https://thetvdb.com/api-information)

variables.name: TMDB API Key
variables.description: Your TMDB API key (get one at https://developer.themoviedb.org/docs/getting-started)

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for file permissions (99 = nobody on Unraid)

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for file permissions (100 = users on Unraid)
